allowedSites.title: Allowed sites
allowedSites.description: If set, only these sites can be watched. An entry like example.com also covers its subdomains.

blockedSites.title: Blocked sites
blockedSites.description: Sites that can never be watched. An entry like example.com also covers its subdomains.

disableCookies.title: Never send cookies
disableCookies.description: Checks never include the user's cookies, so watches can't act as the signed-in user.

disableRenderInTab.title: Disable render-in-tab mode
disableRenderInTab.description: Pages are only downloaded and parsed; their scripts never run.

disableLiveMode.title: Disable live mode
disableLiveMode.description: The extension never observes open tabs.
